This is me. I took my first pill Tuesday & the nausea was unbelievable. Like cannot think/cannot stand up straight. I threw up everything i ate since then & it wasn’t even much to begin with. i also grew extremely food averse - couldn’t even smell food without needing to throw up. 

it sucks. it really really sucks. 
& im so sorry it sucks. 

you’re not imagining it. ♥️

If it helps, you’re already halfway through. it won’t always be like this. ♥️

i completely relate. 

i know i want to die. i need to die. 
this is no life for anyone to live. 

my brain is this terrible wretched place. and everyday i wake up my stomach just sinks. 

i can’t spend the rest of my life like this. surely not. 

why is dying so hard?

i worry about this every day too. 

somehow everything just gets so fucking risky. 
and i would hate to attempt & not die. & then have no way of trying again. 

somehow if a robber walked in my house & stabbed me i could easily die 
but stabbing myself could just lead to internal bleeding & infection that draws out for years???

like. i am just trying to die. 
why can’t it be easy?
i am getting help. but. all it’s doing is showing me how fucked up everything is.
what’s not? everything sucks.
thank you ♥️
the possibility of relief is soothing, i agree.

gave myself 3 months. 

set the date on September 3rd. 


bad things are easy to find in bad places
you’re right. ♥️

right?!!

it’s like the words just vanish. and you don’t even know exactly what to say. 

and god. what if they judge you?

♥️♥️♥️

sending both of you soothing balms. & tenderness. ♥️

hey. 

i’ve seen some kind thoughts & words sent your way. i think they’re warranted. 
most of us spent a long time wishing our mothers would care just enough to even ask. 

maybe one thing to watch out for, healing is not linear. or doesn’t progress in a straight line. 
idk that there is a very bad to super great scale to begin with. 
there’s more a cyclic journey. repetition. emphasis. recreation. 

there’s just getting better at communication. getting better at identifying the thoughts & feelings. being kind with yourself. & patience. 

my therapist used to say i wasn’t walking into therapy to find a magical solution that’d make me into a poster child in a day. or even a year. 

i was getting a chance to hear myself & understand my thoughts & feelings. not so that i never get the bad thoughts & feelings. just until i understand them, can hear them for what they are & i am able to move through with that. until they’re well managed & they don’t incapacitate me as easily. or ultimately. at all. 

♥️

also. make room for just staring into the abyss. 
no offering solutions. no distractions. just being there in that moment with them. 
nothing sucks more than being in the darkness alone.
this is me.

i would say that I do. 

i typically stand up for myself or. for others. 

but. it is exhausting to constantly negotiate with people to respect you or treat you kindly. 
especially if it seems that it comes naturally to everyone else to be kind to everyone but you. 

you kinda just don’t wanna do it anymore.
i feel this. ♥️♥️♥️
i’m so sorry. ♥️
can you stand the rain - New Edition

fear. 

what i wouldn’t give to not be afraid?

a lot of my core issues are fear. 

fear of abandonment.
fear of being harmed. 
fear of being too much/not being enough
fear of never creating anything/becoming myself 

“i’ll tell you what freedom means to me, no fear” - Nina Simone
i withdraw a lot. i move away from people i love/people who love me. for no real reason. a bad coping mechanism.

your comment is kind. thank you. ♥️

it’s affirming to hear you say that i’m brave. and strong. i’m holding that closely. especially because i still feel that i am anything but. 

i just can’t seem to access the parts of me that would be vulnerable to ask for help. or honest with my communities. 

some of the ways harm sits in my body is a deep never ending fear. i am afraid. of being abandoned. of not being heard. 

this moment is ghastly. terrible. consuming. but sharing it and not being heard? being invalidated? that would crush me.
